resources.string: Detects distracting applications and shows a protected lock screen when usage limits are reached.
Keeps phone and app limits active.
A required permission was disabled. Open Focus Guard to restore protection.
Your phone limit has been reached.
The phone will reopen when the lock time ends.
Come back tomorrow after your usage resets.
Enter the parent PIN to return to the app.
Draw the parent pattern to return to the app. Tap a selected dot to start again.
Incorrect pattern. Tap a selected dot to try again.
Focus Guard uses device administration to protect the app’s safety settings. Full uninstall blocking is available only when this device is managed by a device owner or work profile.
Disabling Focus Guard removes its protection. A parent should enter the credential in Focus Guard before changing this setting.
